messages:
maria_partnerships: Heads-up — QuantumMesh PO QM-5112 is stuck because vendor redlined payment terms to NET45 but marketplace policy enforces NET30. Customer pushing for instrument delivery next week. Need decision.

tj_procurement: saw the rejection: portal returned PAYMENT_TERMS_NOT_PERMITTED. Our marketplace config enforces NET30 for hardware appliances unless finance exec waiver.

vendor_evs: from EvS vendor ops: we require NET45 for new accounts due to credit cycles. Can we do a one-time NET45?

olivia_legal: legal note: changing payment term affects T&Cs and revenue recognition. We can approve a commercial-side amendment but need signer authority + updated SOW. If procurement requests waiver, we need exec written approval and a contract exception record.

ben_sales: customer (QuantumMesh) needs units onsite Tue. If we insist on NET30 vendor will walk, they claim higher cost to expedite. Any temporary workaround besides changing terms?

ops_bot: Automated alert: PO QM-5112 validation failed. Error: {code: 403, msg: 'PAYMENT_TERMS_NOT_PERMITTED: NET45 not allowed for hardware category'}

maria_partnerships: Options I see: 1) procurement negotiates vendor to accept NET30 for this PO (fast if vendor agrees), 2) partnerships asks Finance for an exception (requires exec sign, ~24-48h), 3) split payment: 50% upfront NET30, remainder NET45 (requires contract amendment). Which path?

tj_procurement: I'll try option 1 first — pinging vendor contact now. If they refuse, I'll open exception request.

vendor_evs: quick reply from vendor: they can do 50/50 split with 50% due NET30 if Redwood accepts invoicing milestone on delivery. Can Redwood ops support milestone invoice?

olivia_legal: milestone invoicing is okay if we update invoice schedule in contract and confirm delivery acceptance criteria. Legal can draft an amendment template; need signers for both sides. Time estimate ~6 business hours once procurement confirms split.

ben_sales: customer agrees to milestone acceptance criteria. They just need shipping to start.

maria_partnerships: plan: tj to confirm split with vendor, procurement to create exception ticket if needed, olivia to stand by for amendment template, ops to allow portal to accept split payment schedule.

ops_bot: portal feature note: split-payment patch available. Command to queue: `portal-patch --po QM-5112 --accept-split-invoice="50/50"`. Requires staging window open.

tj_procurement: Vendor accepted 50/50. I'm authoring the invoice schedule and uploading vendor confirmation: https://files.redwood/qm/QM-5112-vendor-confirm.pdf

olivia_legal: received vendor confirmation. Drafting amendment now. Will post completed doc here for signatures.

ops_bot: portal-patch queued and applied. PO retried.

maria_partnerships: Portal accepted PO QM-5112 with split payment. Shipping can proceed. Closing thread unless legal flags final doc.

olivia_legal: amendment uploaded: https://contracts.redwood/QM-5112-amend.pdf — signing flow triggered for both parties. Document includes audit note for exception.

ben_sales: Thanks team — customer notified and logistics scheduled. :thumbsup:
